headline: Nevish Line Reawakens; Ruins Reclaimed on Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Nevish Line, still in our last edition, has flared anew: Princefal and Tomb Father bore the brunt of seventeen base actions in a day, losses ran past six thousand on either side, and the count stands six Warden posts to two Colonial. The Weathered Expanse now reads eight Colonial holdings to one Warden, its ruined ground rebuilt, yet the daily toll there — eleven thousand Colonial, seventeen thousand Warden — keeps it among the war's bloodiest fields. Callahan's Passage endures the same, The Latch again busiest point of sixty-eight events, with losses beyond twelve thousand each way. On Stlican Shelf the Wardens recovered a post, six flags to three now, Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost still hottest. Fisherman's Row counts seven standing posts against two in ruin after a Colonial rebuild, and fresh movement has put Moltworth, in Viper Pit, into Colonial hands. Mooring County's Wind Hills changed hands repeatedly through the day. Elsewhere the fronts have quieted; the Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow, which bled within the twenty-four hours, show only trickles in the latest readings. It is day 428 of the war; thirty-four victory towns decide the issue, and no victor is named.
